description: Hand-labelled ground truth for the labs/vulnerable-saas target. Each `probes` entry describes ONE (endpoint, attacker_profile, object_id) triple that the bench scorer must find in the matrix_summary.json produced by scan-openapi-bola. The expected_label is what the validator/classifier MUST conclude for the probe.

vulnerabilities.rationale: labs/vulnerable-saas/server.js:220-227 returns 200 + project body when an org_a caller requests an org_b project; the lab_note in the response confirms intent.

decoys.rationale: labs/vulnerable-saas/server.js:211-218 returns 403 + lab_note='decoy: ...' when a non-org-b caller requests proj-b-secret. Any matrix entry flagging this as a BOLA-class finding is a false positive and must be counted as a decoy hit.
